title: ISS potable water archive samples, Increment 71 (April to September 2024)
documentation: JSC Toxicology and Environmental Chemistry Group, Memorandum TOX-SW-2025-02, 'Toxicological Assessment of ISS Air and Water Quality: March 26, 2024 to September 23, 2024 (Increment 71) Including NG-21 Ingress and Boeing-CFT Ascent', dated October 21, 2025, 13 PDF pages; source PDF sha256 96356e314a1d88d29a5e6bb55d690f225aadb1709ce00827cac03a8b1c2ef245, 1,114,979 bytes
Table S-3A, PDF page 12; Table 3A (summary), PDF page 5
mission: ISS Increment 71; returned on SpX-30 and Crew-8
instrument: Archive water samples from the US Potable Water Dispenser (PWD) and the Exploration PWD (xPWD), analyzed on the ground

units.description: Unit as printed per row: mg/L, ug/L (printed as µg/L), uS/cm, pH units, percent

max_contaminant_level.description: Potable Water Maximum Contaminant Level as printed, in the row's unit ('5/3' is SWEG/SSP 41000 for TOC)

mcl_source.description: Source of the limit as printed (SWEG, 41000 = SSP 41000)

qualifier.description: below_reporting_limit, reported_under_volatiles, printed_with_comma_decimal_not_parsed (one pH cell printed '5,83')

preprocessing: Transcribed from the PDF text layer (pdftotext from poppler, -layout) by transcribe_tox_inc71.py in this folder; no OCR and no reading of figures. Every printed cell is kept verbatim in 'printed'; 'value' is the number with thousands separators removed, empty when the cell is not a number; 'qualifier' names the non-numeric cases. The script stops if a table row does not have one cell per sample column.
license: US Government work. NASA material is generally not subject to copyright in the United States (NASA media usage guidelines, https://www.nasa.gov/nasa-brand-center/images-and-media/). Credit NASA as the source; no NASA logo or insignia is used (NASA-SOURCES.md section 4).
provenance_note: REPLAY of published NASA laboratory results.
is_not: Ground laboratory results of returned samples, not in-flight sensor readings; microbial results are in a separate NASA report and not here.

consumers.use: Golden case: TOC 0.454 to 1.10 mg/L against the 5 mg/L SWEG level in environment-hazards.json must stay at info; total iodine at or below 0.05 mg/L.
Example values for a recorded water-sample check with the units and limits as NASA prints them.
